title: File:Mural in corridor ETH Zurich main building 2026.JPG
desc: Corridor in the ETH Zurich main building with a large figurative mural at the far end. The vaulted ceiling features painted decorations. The corridor has polished floors reflecting the overhead lighting and a row of balusters along one side. The mural depicts a group of people in a workshop or labor

title: File:Wooden cabinet display ETH Zurich main building 2026.JPG
desc: Exhibition display inside a wooden cabinet at the ETH Zurich main building. The open cabinet door reveals a miniature study scene with framed historical photographs, a green desk lamp, old books, and a small writing desk with drawers. Information panels are mounted on the inside of the door.

title: File:ETH Zurich main building ground floor arcades 2026.JPG
desc: Ground floor interior of the ETH Zurich main building (Hauptgebäude). View through Romanesque-style arcades with round arches and stone columns. The hall features mosaic tile flooring and a multi-story arcade gallery visible above. Soft interior lighting.
